normal.name: The Boss Rush Network
normal.text: In this clip, Nick Dimitrescu, Corey Dirrig, and LeRon Dawkins dive into the reality of using Steam OS. Nick shares his personal frustrations with the Steam Deck glitching out during simple tasks—like attempting to play Clone Hero with guitar controllers—leading the group to debate whether Valve should stick to making games rather than battling complex operating systems. #BossRushPodcast #BossRushLive #SteamDeck #SteamOS #GamingNews

normal.name: Blackcat
normal.text: 🎃 10 Days of Horror — Day 2/10 — October 13 Dead Space (2008) launched today, and it still stands as the gold standard of sci-fi survival horror. Isaac Clarke's trip through the USG Ishimura turned dismemberment into a game mechanic. Also released today: 📅 2015: Crusaders of the Lost Idols 📅 2016: Blameless 📅 2020: Werewolf: The Apocalypse — Heart of the Forest #Gaming #OnThisDay #RetroGaming #DeadSpace #Horror #Spooktober
